sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint card reports 480B total, 35B activated, 262,144 native tokens, non-thinking mode, and function calling. Text-generation examples use a causal language model.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder: Agentic Coding in the World
sources.evidence: July 22, 2025 announcement explicitly introduces this exact 480B/35B MoE variant; describes repository-scale coding and 256K native context extensible to 1M with YaRN.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM; qwen3_moe; 62 layers; 160 experts with 8 selected per token; max_position_embeddings 262144. Text-token causal model configuration.

sources.title: Alibaba Unveils Cutting-Edge AI Coding Model Qwen3-Coder
sources.evidence: Alibaba identifies this as its released Qwen3-Coder model, explicitly specifying 480B total and 35B activated per token. This July 23 corporate release follows Qwen's July 22 announcement.

description.note: Replaces subjective heavyweight wording with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Open-weight Qwen MoE model for agentic coding and repository-scale understanding.
patch.notes: 480B total and 35B activated per token are developer-reported nominal counts. Native context is 262,144 tokens; 1M requires extrapolation. Non-thinking output mode.

summary: Confirmed 480B total, 35B activated per token, MoE, July 22 launch, native 262,144 context, text modalities, non-thinking mode and tool calling. Adds Apache-2.0 license, promotes parameter evidence to primary sources, and makes the description factual. No unresolved audited fields.
